A26.name: Coronado Silver Metallic
A26.notes: hex published by PaintScratch in page data (PS_SSR.hex / swatch background-color), not converted from RGB. Metallic per name. Mitsubishi name 'Coronado Silver Metallic' from AutomotiveTouchup 3000GT 1994-1999 (https://automotivetouchup.com/touch-up-paint/mitsubishi/1996/3000gt). STRONG DISAGREEMENT: PaintScratch Mitsubishi A26 'Coronado Sand Metallic' (1995-2004 Truck, Lancer, Diamante, FTO; not 3000GT) = #E0DBC8 (https://www.paintscratch.com/colors/mitsubishi/coronado-sand-metallic-a26/).

Mitsubishi name 'Seattle Silver Metallic' from AutomotiveTouchup 3000GT 1996-1999 (https://automotivetouchup.com/touch-up-paint/mitsubishi/1996/3000gt). Metallic per name.
